Accuracy measures for change detection

Source: R/metrics.R
change_detection_metrics.Rd

Computes the usual accuracy measures of binary change maps: detection rate (DR, percentage of true changes that were detected), false alarm rate (FA, percentage of unchanged pixels flagged as changed), and the percentages of false positives (FP) and false negatives (FN) with respect to all pixels.

Usage

change_detection_metrics(truth, estimate)

Arguments

truth

Logical (or 0/1) vector/matrix of true changes.

estimate

Logical (or 0/1) vector/matrix of detected changes.

Value

A tibble with DR, FA, FP, FN (in percent) and the overall accuracy OA (in percent).

Examples

truth <- c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE)
est <- c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)
change_detection_metrics(truth, est)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>      DR    FA    FP    FN    OA
#>   <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1    50  33.3    20    20    60
